f0.source: Johnson & Christy 1974, "Optical constants of transition metals", Physical Review B 9:5056 (chromium, n 3.18, k 3.30 near 550 nm)
f0.derivation: ((n - 1)^2 + k^2) / ((n + 1)^2 + k^2); chromium is grey: its F0 varies under 1 % across the primaries (Hoffman 2020, "Physically Based Shading", SIGGRAPH course: 0.549, 0.556, 0.554)

f82.derivation: Fresnel's reflectance of the complex index at the incidence cosine 1/7 (Optics.ush, MatterConductorFresnel)

diffuseAlbedo.source: Chromium(III) oxide, the passive film (eskolaite green)
diffuseAlbedo.note: Chromium's passive film is a few nanometres of Cr2O3 and shows no colour; these numbers are the oxide's, which no museum history grows.

refractiveIndex.source: Anthony et al., Handbook of Mineralogy (eskolaite, Cr2O3: n 2.5 to 2.6)

roughness.note: Unused while the cover is nil.

cover.source: the tarnish's cover is its history's
cover.derivation: unused: the history gives the cover
